messages:
alex_support: FYI customer on prod reported immediate 403s from signing endpoint after our region failover — says keys "disappeared" from key listing. Trying to triage.
maria_sre: Got the ticket link? Customer env = eu-central-1 private deployment, CloudHSM cluster behind VPC. Any recent maintenance windows? :thinking_face:
jordan_support: https://support.example.com/tkt/99421 — they reported error payload: `\{\"code\":403, \"message\":\"key not found\"}` and attempted key list returns empty array for the CMK id.
ashwin_eng: pinging HSM team. Can you paste the HSM cluster id and the last rotation time? Also need the exact call made (ListKeys vs DescribeKey vs Sign).
alex_support: Customer sent this (redacted): `POST /v1/crypto/sign` body: `{key_id: "cmk-eu-123", alg: "RSASSA-PSS"}` -> 403. They tried `GET /v1/keys?filter=cmk-eu-123` -> []. They say kms-audit shows prior signs earlier today.
sec_ops: @maria_sre important: customer is asking for audit logs and retention proof — they need timeline and whether HSM ever had key material. Please preserve logs and don't rotate key until we confirm.
incident-bot: Incident created: IN-2026-0432 | HSM key visibility loss | priority=P1
maria_sre: I ran quick health check on the CloudHSM cluster: two nodes show UNHEALTHY in the AWS console but cluster is still 'available'. Asking AWS support for HSM pod status.
aws_support: (from aws-support) We see a brief AZ network flap at 2026-03-15T14:12Z which caused cluster sync retries. No automatic deletion of key material, but PKCS#11 token may be temporarily inaccessible until replication finishes.
ashwin_eng: Ok that points at a replication lag. Can we get CloudHSM logs from the customer's cluster? Ask them for `cloudhsm-cli --show-status` output and the Luna client logs from their app node.
customer-eng: I asked and they attached these snippets:
```
cloudhsm-cli> list clusters
Cluster: c-hsm-eu-01  state=active  nodes=3
cloudhsm-cli> show token cmk-eu-123
Error: Token not found
```
They also attached app logs showing repeated RPC retries:
```
2026-03-15T14:13:02Z sign request -> 403 key not found
2026-03-15T14:13:06Z retry -> 503 service unavailable
```
maria_sre: Can we confirm whether the key object was evicted from our cache layer vs truly missing from HSM? We have prefix-caching for keys; if HSM returned empty, cache TTL might have cleared on failover.
ashwin_eng: I checked our cache-metrics — cache miss rate spiked at 14:12Z and prefix-cache invalidation triggered due to cluster-health policy. However on reconnection we should rehydrate from HSM. Need HSM token listing.
jordan_support: Customer is anxious, asking if their key material was lost (legal question). Sec_ops wants exact audit timestamps and any KMS/HSM access events.
sec_ops: We need: (1) HSM cluster audit logs (AWS CloudTrail + CloudHSM native), (2) KMS request logs, (3) internal Redis/cache eviction events. Don't do any key rotation until we validate.
alex_support: Customer provided CloudTrail event showing CreateKey months ago and many Sign events until 14:12Z. No DeleteKey events present.
aws_support: Confirmed: CloudTrail shows no DeleteKey or UnwrapKey events. The brief network partition led to token sync backlog; replication worker is still catching up — estimated 7–9 minutes from snapshot.
maria_sre: Actionable next steps: (A) ask customer to run `sudo journalctl -u luna-client | tail -n 200` and paste lines around 14:12, (B) we collect our cache logs and correlation id for sign requests, (C) Sec_ops will gather audit bundle.
customer-eng: Pasted luna-client excerpt:
```
Mar 15 14:12:05 luna-client[2345]: cloudhsm: disconnected from cluster c-hsm-eu-01
Mar 15 14:12:09 luna-client[2345]: cloudhsm: token sync backlog=124
Mar 15 14:12:30 luna-client[2345]: token cmk-eu-123 reimported id=0x5a2f
```
aws_support: That last line suggests replication completed and token re-imported — token id mapping present. That aligns with our assumption: temporary unavailability, not deletion.
sec_ops: Good — we can reassure customer that key material did not leave HSM. We'll prepare formal statement and produce audit bundle: CloudTrail + HSM native logs + internal request traces.
ashwin_eng: For mitigation, suggest we add stronger read-through on cache rehydration (backfill on token reimport) and make our sign endpoint return 202 + retry hint instead of immediate 403 when HSM shows no token but cluster health is degraded.
maria_sre: Also adding CloudHSM cluster health alert → page SRE on unhealthy node count >=1 for >2m. That would have caught this earlier.
jordan_support: Customer message: "Thanks — please confirm our keys are intact and we'll await the official audit export." They're asking if we can expedite the audit export.
alex_support: Sec_ops, can you produce the bundle and a one-paragraph summary we can send to the customer? Also include the window and explanation: network flap -> token sync backlog -> temporary token invisibility -> no deletion.
sec_ops: On it. ETA 45min for curated bundle and statement. We will mark incident IN-2026-0432 and attach artifact.
incident-bot: Updated IN-2026-0432: sec_ops assigned; status=investigating
maria_sre: I'll follow-up to implement the cache and alert work items in backlog once incident closes. Filed JIRA RF-3241.
alex_support: Closing loop here after audit send. Thanks everyone for quick triage. :thumbsup:\n
